import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()

# Wait more
import time
time.sleep(8)

# Try again
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s http://localhost:3000/health 2>&1")
print("Health:", stdout.read().decode()[:200])

# Check more logs
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -10 /var/log/areloria/out-0.log 2>&1")
print("\nLogs:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
